summary:
再生元上季 EPS 11.44 美元超預期 6.38%、營收 38.8 億美元，Dupixent 帶動穩健獲利。
• EPS 11.44 美元，超預期 6.38%，獲利穩健
• 營收 38.8 億美元，產品組合貢獻多元
• Dupixent 跨適應症持續放量
• 管線進展（腫瘤、免疫）支撐長期成長
ai_view:
訊號正向：EPS 超預期顯示 Dupixent 與產品組合支撐穩健獲利。短期財報利多支撐股價。惟對照下一季 EPS 大幅低於預期，可見 Eylea 競爭壓力正快速浮現。中期關鍵在 Dupixent 動能、Eylea HD 防禦力與腫瘤管線兌現。15倍本益比提供估值緩衝，催化劑為臨床數據與新藥核准。

需留意：本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限；Eylea 競爭與生物相似藥威脅；管線臨床與監管不確定性

summary_en:
Regeneron beat EPS at $11.44 by 6.38% on $3.88B revenue, with Dupixent driving solid earnings.
• EPS of $11.44 beat by 6.38%, solid profitability
• Revenue of $3.88B with diversified portfolio contribution
• Dupixent continues ramping across indications
• Pipeline progress in oncology and immunology supports long-term growth

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: the EPS beat shows Dupixent and the portfolio supporting solid earnings. Near term the beat supports the stock. However, the next quarter's large miss shows Eylea competitive pressure emerging quickly. Mid term, the keys are Dupixent momentum, Eylea HD defense and oncology pipeline delivery. A ~15x P/E offers a valuation cushion, with catalysts in clinical data and approvals.

Watch：Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility; Eylea competition and biosimilar threat; Pipeline clinical and regulatory uncertainty
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 6.38%，獲利優於估計（營收年增率未提供）。
